name: Staked Yuzu USD
oneLiner: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper of yzUSD; share price accrues yield from overcollateralized DeFi strategies on Plasma and Monad.

collateral: Staked wrapper over Yuzu USD, backed by yzUSD reserve assets deployed into curated DeFi yield strategies and overcollateralized by protocol risk tranching
pegMechanism: Users stake yzUSD for syzUSD; syzUSD appreciates against yzUSD as strategy yield accrues, and final exits inherit Yuzu's KYC-gated primary redemption and liquidity-buffer constraints

oracleRisk.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper over yzUSD; its share price accrues strategy yield and the wrapper does not expose a separate borrower collateral market or token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu documents syzUSD as a technical staking wrapper: users convert yzUSD into syzUSD shares and can unstake back to yzUSD. The reviewed wrapper has no borrower-owned debt positions or separate collateral/liquidation branches; underlying yzUSD mechanics remain a parent-asset dependency.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: syzUSD moves cross-chain between Plasma and Monad via a LayerZero OVault. Yuzu's own audited contracts (ovault/ProtoOVaultComposer and PSMOVaultComposer) inherit LayerZero's VaultComposerSync and wire an asset+share OFT mesh, with the share token (syzUSD) explicitly required to be an OFTAdapter lockbox (approvalRequired()==true) on the hub chain (most likely Plasma) and a standard OFT on spokes. Because the durable supply path for shares runs through a third-party (LayerZero) OFTAdapter lockbox control surface, this is an external lock/mint route rather than opaque. (Named DVN set and a live LayerZeroScan trace were not pinned, and the on-chain hub identity was not confirmed at the explorer/deploy-config level, but the lockbox/adapter requirement is code-enforced in the issuer's audited composer.)

mintAuthority.summary: syzUSD is Yuzu's staking wrapper of yzUSD; shares are minted only by staking yzUSD into the ERC-4626 vault, so it inherits yzUSD's permissioned (eligible-investor-gated) mint authority rather than creating new yzUSD supply.

controls.label: syzUSD ERC-4626 staking vault (share accounting)
controls.evidence: syzUSD is an ERC-4626 vault that mints/burns shares against yzUSD deposits (expected asset 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc); share price appreciates as strategy yield accrues. The wrapper cannot create base yzUSD supply.

controls.label: Inherited yzUSD permissioned mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying yzUSD primary mint/redeem is gated to KYC'ed eligible investors 1:1 with USDT0, with collateral managed in a Fordefi MPC workspace. syzUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture from the parent.

review.evidence: syzUSD (variantOf yzusd-yuzu, variantKind strategy-vault) is an ERC-4626 staked wrapper over yzUSD on Plasma and Monad. It inherits yzUSD's permissioned-minter mint path and concentrated-admin posture; the wrapper only mints/burns shares against yzUSD deposits.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classified as the staked variant of yzusd-yuzu per coin metadata and Yuzu docs; posture mirrored from the parent yzUSD mintAuthority. The vault's own admin was not independently resolved on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Plasma deployment 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6: transparent proxy confirmed (admin slot = ProxyAdmin 0x7392751a860a51694231c7a0b4a9c853f8169cf0; ProxyAdmin owner = 4/5 Safe 0xa2a9700407934e913c840556b3d29f19cf6f203d, Safe masterCopy=0x29fcb43, no modules). HOWEVER vault owner() = EOA 0xceaff57fbcd0e8f095c5c1125dd09b93fc5bbf82 (code=0x). Per brief, an EOA owner is verifiable as authorityType:eoa — but this is a wrapper with a separate upgrade admin (the 4/5 Safe). Promote when the EOA role is clarified (operational vs upgrade) or if the project confirms EOA is an MPC/HSM wallet.
